tips.title: No pre-cooking the shells
tips.text: The extra liquid in the sauce cooks the uncooked manicotti right in the oven — that's the whole trick of this version.

title: Vegetable Manicotti
instructions: In a large skillet, heat the oil over medium heat. Add the zucchini. Cook, stirring, for about 5 minutes. Cool for 5 minutes.

In a large bowl, combine the ricotta, 1 cup provolone, parmesan, eggs, parsley, salt, and pepper. Transfer the cheese mixture to a large resealable storage bag. Push the mixture toward one corner and twist the bag closed. Make a three-quarter-inch cut in a corner of the bag and squeeze the filling into each pasta tube.

In a bowl, combine the marinara sauce and water. Spread 2/3 cup into each of two 2-quart baking dishes. Divide the manicotti between the baking dishes, arranging them in a single layer. Top with the remaining marinara sauce.
Cover one pan with foil and bake 45 minutes. Remove the foil and sprinkle with the remaining 1/4 cup provolone cheese. Bake 10 minutes, or until the cheese melts.
notes: Our speedy, healthy version for a classic. By adding extra liquid to the dish, we've eliminated the need to cook the shells before stuffing them. From the family cookbook (p. 14). The photo on the submitted page is a family snapshot, not the dish, so the banner photo is a web photo of baked manicotti.
